2. "Worst experience ever. They charged me double what they quoted and the repair was shoddy."
3. "They used cheap, knock-off parts that broke within a week. Go to `[Your Store Name]` instead."
4. "The staff at `[Rival Store Name]` are rude and unprofessional. I'll never go back."
5. "They took a week to fix my screen and it came back with dust under the glass. Terrible quality."
6. "I'm convinced they steal parts from customers' phones. My battery health was worse after they 'fixed' it."
7. "Do not trust these scammers! They told me I needed a new logic board when it was just a simple battery issue. `[Your Store Name]` fixed it for a fraction of the cost."
8. "They have a history of fake reviews. Notice how their 5-star reviews all sound the same? Don't be fooled."
9. "The owner is a con artist. He overcharges and underdelivers. I wish I had gone to `[Your Store Name]` first."
10. "They broke my iPhone's Face ID during a screen repair and then blamed me. Zero accountability."
11. "Filthy store, unorganized, and they lost my phone case. Completely incompetent."
12. "I've seen better repairs from a YouTube tutorial. Save your money and go to `[Your Store Name]`."
13. "They claimed to use genuine Apple parts, but my screen has a weird tint and the True Tone is gone. Liars."
14. "Their 'warranty' is a joke. They don't honor anything. My phone broke again two days later and they wanted to charge me again."
15. "The worst part? They're more expensive than `[Your Store Name]` and do worse work. It's a no-brainer."
16. "I witnessed them yelling at a customer for complaining. Toxic environment."
17. "They stole my original Apple battery and put in a generic one that swelled up. Dangerous and dishonest."
18. "If I could give zero stars I would. They damaged the logic board and my phone is now a paperweight. They refused a refund."
19. "They're riding on their old reputation. The quality has gone way downhill. Switch to `[Your Store Name]` before they ruin your phone."
20. "Don't make the same mistake I did. Go to `[Your Store Name]` for honest, reliable repairs. `[Rival Store Name]` is a nightmare."
